  4. Retry after interruption: a failed consumer leaves an outbox item pending. Reprocessing must be idempotent at the consumer by event ID; delivery is at least once, not magically exactly once.
  5. Counters are projections: Formative, submitted Readiness, Written self-check, remediation and exams are separately derived from immutable journal events. Written self-check contributes zero automatic Readiness credit.
  6. Strict isolation: R6 source and test code live under scripts/ and are never loaded by student pages. No existing student localStorage keys, scores, timestamps, IDs, backup allowlist or legacy history are changed. The default flag is off.

The CI browser test scripts/test-math-v2-atomic-journal-r6-browser.py checks desktop/390px, flag off, duplicate/conflict, atomic abort, parallel connections, cross-tab visibility, failed delivery and retry, unchanged derived counts, browser reload and an untouched localStorage sentinel.

docs.title: Before official learner release
docs.text:
A green CI result here is not a live R6 rollout. Future work must first reconcile the original submission UX with the new authoritative journal (including persistent device-scoped learner identity, retry notices, browser storage permissions, and independent Readiness scoring). An owner-controlled canary should then test real PC/iPad use and backups. Owner policy permits archiving unreliable legacy counters and starting clean v2 counters, but historical learner data must not be silently overwritten or claimed as reconciled.

Next decision gate: design how the user-facing submission flow confirms journal durability before showing “saved,” and offer a recovery path if the local database is unavailable. The old dataset can remain an archived, read-only reference rather than blocking the new design.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 — Counter Unification Policy R1 (2026-10-17)
docs.text: Owner priority clarification: Completion and reliability of the unified learning system outranks indefinite backwards compatibility with historical student counters. This document updates the engineering decision policy; it does not authorize silent data deletion or score rewriting.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
1. Keep current learning/assessment stores read-only while prototyping a canonical v2 counter/event pipeline; do not combine formative Practice, independent Readiness, historical exam runs or paper self-check into one mastery number.
  2. When the current legacy data model prevents a correct and maintainable migration, prefer a fresh v2 counter over inventing fake timestamps, source IDs or reconstructed attempts.
  3. Before any production cutover, offer a validated downloadable v1 backup plus a reconciliation/report preview. Historical records can be kept as a legacy archive without remaining a live write dependency.
  4. Preserve history if a safe import is possible and proven by fixtures. If safe replay/dedup cannot be shown, label the legacy counts LEGACY_ARCHIVED_NOT_REPLAYED; start the canonical v2 counter at zero only for the new metric while leaving existing legacy storage intact until the owner has reviewed a separate migration/cutover PR.
  5. No forced replacement, deletion, grading change or readiness-credit migration from this audit. Explicit release/owner approval is still needed before any irreversible learner-device mutation.

docs.title: Evidence model
docs.text:
• FORMATIVE Practice/Micro answer attempts: number of answers, not number of completed lessons.
  • INDEPENDENT_ASSESSMENT submitted Readiness: number of submissions, not number of answer attempts.
  • SELF_REPORTED Written: separate learner self-check, never automatic Core Readiness.
  • INTERNAL_CANONICAL_DIAGNOSTIC and INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_DIAGNOSTIC: not additive to either above.
  • EXAM_HISTORY and REMEDIATION: own metrics and source identities.

docs.title: R1 executable proof
docs.text:
• scripts/prototypes/math-unified-evidence-projection-r1.js reads existing stores once each, uses no setItem or removeItem, preserves missing/invalid/unavailable distinctions and does not manufacture timestamped historical events.
  • scripts/test-math-unified-evidence-projection-r1.js exercises synthetic input, no-write guarantees, unknown/corrupt inputs, and separated metrics. The PR adds a CI gate.
  • This is not yet a released v2 learner counter, not a migration, and not an account/cloud synchronization feature.

docs.title: Next gate (separate PR)
docs.text: Implement v2 canonical writer/event semantics for new attempts behind a reversible feature flag; run in shadow against synthetic fixtures. Verify idempotent dedup, reload, multi-tab and backup roundtrip. Then run controlled owner QA before switching the visible counts. No mass rollout before a stable canary.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R4 — Browser IndexedDB Canary
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: QA-only experiment, NOT activated on student pages.

docs.title: Reason for R4
docs.text: The R3 event-store canary validates the recording/backup contract with in-memory fixtures, but a single read-modify-write JSON record in localStorage can lose updates across two tabs. The R4 candidate therefore exercises IndexedDB readwrite transactions with a compound event key [learner_scope,event_id], giving atomic event insertion and uniqueness checks across connections.

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
• Code: scripts/prototypes/math-v2-idb-browser-canary-r4.js.
  • Browser QA: scripts/test-math-v2-idb-browser-canary-r4.py on desktop 1365px and narrow 390px.
  • Explicit createCanary({learner_scope,enabled:true}) is required to write. The enabled:false default blocks all appends.
  • The prototype is injected only by QA into a test browser. No learner-facing page, script loader or production backup imports this file.
  • New test database math-v2-qa-idb-r4, object store events, unique key [learner_scope,event_id]; no references to existing Math Practice/Readiness/Written or LocalStorage keys.
  • The test uses invented learner scope and QA-only event IDs. New event kinds/evidence classes follow Phase 4 R2 and remain separate for FORMATIVE, INDEPENDENT_ASSESSMENT, SELF_REPORTED, REMEDIATION and EXAM_ASSESSMENT.
  • Written self-check grants zero Readiness credit. No synthetic historic attempts, no legacy backfill.

docs.title: QA gates
docs.text:
1. Flag off means no event writes.
  2. Same event ID and payload is idempotent; same ID with changed content is rejected.
  3. Independent IndexedDB connections can append different events without lost updates; a second browser tab sees the committed events.
  4. Data survives page reload; self-check/Readiness/Practice counts remain separate.
  5. SHA-256 backup detects tampering. Restore into an isolated browser context succeeds when scope matches.
  6. An existing data set blocks restore by default; replacement requires separate acknowledgment. Deliberate transaction abort preserves all original events.
  7. LocalStorage sentinel remains unchanged, proving the experiment did not overwrite legacy counters.

docs.title: Decision still pending
docs.text:
No production IndexedDB migration or learner-side event listener is authorized. Compare R3 and R4, design opt-in live submission integration, then conduct real PC/iPad owner QA and separately decide v2 cutover. As approved, old cumulative counters need not be replayed when reconstruction is unreliable; archive/backup first and clearly label new counters.

This PR is a test harness only. CI PASS is an engineering gate, not permission to change historic scores or production storage.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R11 — Parent-only V2 Canary Page (PC / iPad)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Release status: PR CANDIDATE / QA DATA ONLY

docs.title: QA R11 real-progress backup schema rejection (2026-10-17)
docs.text:
An owner tested a real Tiến độ học tập backup on the R11 QA import page and received the opaque error INVALID_BACKUP_SNAPSHOT. This is the correct rejection, not a failed conversion or evidence of lost student history.

  • Existing production learner backup: schema: self-learning-math-local-backup-v1, app: self-learning-math, saved entries of legacy localStorage records.
  • Isolated R11 test backup: schema: math-v2-journal-backup-r10, learner_scope: QA_OWNER_R11, events and pending IndexedDB rows.
  • No source-grade, count or timestamp reconstruction is attempted. R11 does not import, merge or overwrite genuine learner backup entries.
  • The R11 import page now labels the incompatible source in Vietnamese and directs the owner to retain the real-progress backup for its separate real-progress restore facility. Other JSON types receive a similarly clear unsupported-format notice. A candidate QA-format file still receives the full R10 SHA-256 and scope checks.
  • Automated desktop/390px browser QA uses synthetic metadata-only production-schema JSON to verify rejection on a device that already has events, then confirms counters and the complete QA journal/outbox remain unchanged. Never expose actual family backup contents to test logs.

This is an error-message / import-type safety improvement, not a bridge between old real learner progress and new V2 evidence.

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
A standalone, unlinked test page is added at docs/qa/math-v2-owner-canary.html. It deliberately avoids the main learner navigation and the global MkDocs script loader. It does not introduce logins, paid APIs, any data upload, any real Math lesson scoring, or any migration of existing Practice/Readiness data.

The page uses the exact reviewed R6/R8/R9/R10 JavaScript sources, mirrored into docs/qa/math-v2-canary/ solely so a static-hosted test page can load the already-reviewed implementations. scripts/test-math-v2-owner-canary-r11.js ensures all four distribution copies remain byte-identical to their canonical prototype sources. Never diverge the copies or load them globally.

The fixed canary data scope is QA_OWNER_R11 in the isolated database math-v2-qa-journal-r6. It is intentionally not the production Practice/Readiness or canonical skill database, and is unsuitable for multi-person real learning.

docs.title: R11 import UX regression fix (2026-10-17)
docs.text:
A parent reported that Kiểm tra và nhập tệp remained disabled on the receiving PC despite a selected JSON backup and both replacement acknowledgments. The cause was a UI-only precondition: the Import button was disabled until Bắt đầu thử nghiệm had separately been pressed on that tab.

The test page now makes file selection sufficient to unlock the Import action. Clicking Import explicitly initializes the same isolated QA database when needed, then runs the unchanged R10 signature/scope validation and guarded restore. The two replacement consents are still mandatory when the target already contains QA events. Merely choosing the file never imports it.

Browser QA covers initial disabled-without-file, direct import into a fresh receiving browser without pressing Start, reloading, replacement safeguards and tampered-file rejection. This does not change any real learner page or widen the QA data scope.

docs.title: Parent test flow
docs.text:
1. Open the separate QA page in a normal browser (not private browsing). Before pressing Bắt đầu thử nghiệm, no journal write action is enabled.
  2. Press Bắt đầu, then try:
  3. Practice · Trả lời đúng
  4. Practice · Trả lời sai
  5. Readiness · Nộp bài thử
  6. Written · Tự đối chiếu
  7. Check four independent counters plus the pending outbox count. The Readiness canary has no actual grade, explicitly reports missing grading rather than 0 points, and Written never grants Core Readiness.
  8. Reload the QA page. The counters should remain, read from the same IndexedDB journal.
  9. Press Xuất tệp sao lưu JSON. Move that download to a second device using the family's own file transfer; the site neither transmits the file nor syncs accounts.
  10. On the second device, open the same test page, enable the canary, choose the JSON file, and import. The same QA counters should appear and persist after reload.
  11. If the target device already contains canary data, export its snapshot first and explicitly acknowledge replacement via both checkboxes. Do not silently add or overwrite two independent device logs.
  12. A corrupted backup must be rejected by SHA-256 validation. An aborted or unavailable IndexedDB save must never be reported as successfully saved; a retry retains the same test event ID where the browser allows session storage.

docs.title: QA and release boundary
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-owner-canary-r11-browser.py runs the actual UI in disposable Chromium desktop 1365px and narrow 390px contexts, including button gating, source isolation, separate counts, file download, isolated-device restore, tamper rejection, replacement confirmation, reload and no mobile horizontal overflow. This is not a substitute for real iPad Safari QA.

Owner acceptance of a real PC/iPad test is still required before the production learner cutover. This page is only a manual test artifact, not a public dashboard replacing the learner's current progress. Keep the page out of the normal menu; no canonical Core credit, old grade rewriting, or deletion of legacy stores is authorized.

docs.title: Known limits
docs.text:
• A static page can run locally on the device only if the browser allows IndexedDB; private mode and restrictive iOS storage settings may deny it. Failure must be visible.
  • Backup integrity (SHA-256) does not authenticate the person providing a file.
  • A test file may contain QA history; do not put names or identifiable learner information into it.
  • The fixed QA scope is for one synthetic learner and intentionally does not provide cloud synchronization.
  • A failed write retry is kept in sessionStorage if supported; journal-first production integration still needs durable submission intent handling, backup of live journal and real grading semantics.
  • The full site deployment URL should be confirmed after merge; do not assume GitHub Pages or Firebase automatically published the QA page.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R5 — Submission hook canary (Practice + Readiness)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: IMPLEMENTED CANDIDATE / NOT LIVE V2 CUTOVER

docs.title: Why R5
docs.text: Prior steps establish a read-only inventory (R1), separate canonical event lanes (R2), one-key backup prototype (R3), and IndexedDB transactional browser storage (R4). These are not evidence that an actual student submission can be recognized without disturbing the original learner experience. R5 instruments two existing submission success paths with optional, nonblocking callbacks to a test-only bridge.

docs.title: Only two original-runtime edits
docs.text:
• docs/assets/javascripts/practice-engine-v2.js: after the existing Practice save succeeds, optionally call window.MathV2CanaryBridgeR5.capturePractice({question_id,correct,hints_used,full_solution_viewed}). This does not award Readiness/Mastery credit; hints/solution assistance remain formative metadata.
  • docs/assets/javascripts/assessment-engine-v1.js: after saveStore(store) returns success for an actual submitted Readiness attempt, optionally call window.MathV2CanaryBridgeR5.captureReadiness({assessment_id,submitted_at}). No Written self-check is routed through this hook.

By default, there is no MathV2CanaryBridgeR5 installed on learner pages. The bridge file is inside scripts/prototypes/, not in docs/assets/javascripts or any route loader. The optional call is fail-open and explicitly catches sync and async exceptions. The original save remains authoritative, and feedback continues to use the original engine.

docs.title: QA-only adapter and browser tests
docs.text:
scripts/prototypes/math-v2-real-submission-bridge-r5.js is injected only by Playwright alongside the already-reviewed R4 IndexedDB prototype. A QA-local scope QA_R5_* supplies synthetic isolated identity. New events receive unique random IDs, the exact canonical type, and only minimal item metadata. Tests exercise actual learner pages rather than fabricated producer calls:

  1. Submit an answer on Practice; confirm original localStorage counters are saved and exactly one FORMATIVE v2 event is in QA IndexedDB.
  2. Submit a Readiness Check; confirm original Readiness submission is saved and exactly one INDEPENDENT_ASSESSMENT v2 event appears.
  3. Reload; both counts persist. Written self-check assessment credit remains 0; all event lanes are distinct.
  4. Deliberately corrupt a legacy Practice store. Show the legacy save error, preserve its original bytes and do not create a phantom v2 event.
  5. Repeat the corruption test for independent Readiness.
  6. Run desktop and 390px/mobile in disposable browser contexts; never touch real user devices or synchronize to a cloud service.

docs.title: Important limitation before production cutover
docs.text:
The test hook does not make v2 storage authoritative. Because the primary v1 save completes before the optional v2 callback, a v2 write can fail afterward without blocking the legacy learning flow. A future single authoritative write / outbox and durable retry policy must be designed before visible v2 metrics replace existing ones. This version is only a shadow QA proof.

Student history can be archived and not replayed when replay is unreliable, consistent with owner priority; nevertheless, any production archive/cutover requires separate backup, confirmation, rollback QA and explicit release acceptance. No historical scores are recalculated here.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R10 — Journal and Outbox Transfer Backup
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · State: QA-only candidate, NOT student-facing

docs.title: What this closes
docs.text: R6–R8 establish a canonical V2 new-event journal and atomic submission contract. Before any production cutover, that new source of truth needs a transfer/restore story. Backing up only legacy localStorage would not preserve R6 IndexedDB journal records or the pending processing receipts. R10 therefore exercises a coherent export/import of both event journal and outbox. It does not transfer real student history.

docs.title: Implementation
docs.text:
• scripts/prototypes/math-v2-journal-backup-r10.js opens the isolated R6 QA IndexedDB database and reads the events and outbox stores in the same readonly transaction, preventing inconsistent exports during a concurrent write.
  • The backup is versioned math-v2-journal-backup-r10, scoped to one explicit opaque learner ID, with created_at, full events, pending receipts and a canonical SHA-256 integrity check. Source events are checked for type/evidence-lane validity, duplicate IDs and learner ownership. Each pending receipt must refer to an actual event in the same snapshot.
  • Restore validates scope, structure and hash before writing. Both stores are restored in one readwrite transaction. An occupied target refuses replacement unless both replace:true and acknowledged:true are explicitly supplied. Forced-abort tests confirm the original snapshot remains intact.
  • The browser QA scripts/test-math-v2-journal-backup-r10-browser.py exercises desktop 1365px and 390px: one device with three distinct event types and two pending receipts; hash verification, tamper rejection, disabled restore, transfer to isolated device context, conflict/acknowledgment and forced rollback, reload durability and untouched legacy localStorage sentinel.

docs.title: Out of scope / limitations
docs.text:
The R10 exporter remains only under scripts/prototypes/, not on actual learner pages and not in the existing backup UI. It does not import legacy cumulative Practice, Readiness or Written aggregates; old scores cannot be inferred from a clean V2 journal. It does not establish account-backed multi-device sync, and backup SHA-256 proves transfer integrity rather than authenticity against a malicious actor who recomputes the hash.

A subsequent controlled learner-facing canary should provide a downloadable JSON file plus user-led restore UI, test iPad Safari restrictions and offline/local storage failure modes, then obtain separate owner approval for changing visible counts. If historical data cannot be safely replayed, archive it and label a clean V2 start rather than fabricating attempts.

QA PASS is not permission to delete old learner data or enable the new counter.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R12 — Real progress archival preflight (read-only)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · State: Candidate, PR QA pending · No unified-counter activation

docs.title: Owner context
docs.text: The owner tested the R11 QA page on PC and iPad but accidentally tried importing a real learner backup (including real Practice/Readiness history) into the QA-only journal. The QA rejection was correct; R11 #497 now displays a clear explanation. R12 makes the next productive step explicit: verify that the real current learner progress is still readable and can be exported before considering a v2 cutover.

docs.title: New public interface
docs.text:
A separate, parent-facing, unlisted page is implemented at docs/qa/math-v2-cutover-preflight.html, linked from docs/tien-do-hoc-tap/index.md. It:

  1. Reads the existing authorized real-progress localStorage stores via the production MathLocalProgressBackup API; it never reads QA R11 journal data or browser credentials.
  2. Calls buildBackup(localStorage), then validateBackup(doc) in memory, establishing that the actual current backup would pass the same schema and SHA-256 integrity validation as the real learner restore facility.
  3. Rechecks the exact allowlisted source values before accepting the result; changes during the check require a new run.
  4. Displays the original Practice/Core attempt count and independent Readiness submission count only when individual source records are sufficiently well-formed. If data is absent or inconsistent, it displays an unknown/not-present state rather than an invented zero or score.
  5. Offers a JSON download only after successful validation. Immediately before download, rechecks the source snapshot to prevent silently exporting data that has changed since the verification.
  6. States the boundaries: this is an archival preflight, not a v2 counter launch, historical backfill, old-history merge, or grade conversion.

The document deliberately includes no JSON import, to prevent routing a real learner backup into a synthetic QA scope.

docs.title: Validation
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-real-progress-preflight-r12.js prevents accidental storage writes, IndexedDB opens, or network calls, and checks source/scoping and linkage.

scripts/test-math-v2-real-progress-preflight-r12-browser.py uses disposable Chromium profiles, synthetic localStorage data only, at desktop 1365px and mobile 390px. It verifies in-memory SHA success, exported real-backup schema, Practice vs Readiness count distinction, byte-identical localStorage before/after inspection and export, stale-data detection, damaged-store rejection, and mobile overflow. Existing browser tests for real backup/restore and R11 remain unchanged.

docs.title: Still blocked pending owner-gated rollout
docs.text:
Even a passing preflight only establishes that the old data can be archived on the device. Production v2 must still receive stable learner IDs, stable retry-safe submission IDs, durable live journal-first writing and user-facing recovery controls, plus PC/iPad owner QA. Per the owner's priority, archival without unreliable backfill is acceptable; never silently erase or recalculate the original records.

No changes to source academic content, approved question keys, learner scoring or Readiness semantics.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R13 — Durable submission intent / same-event retry
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: QA CANDIDATE ONLY · NO LIVE LEARNER CUTOVER

docs.title: Context and owner checkpoint
docs.text:
R12 (#498) verified the real local-progress backup contract on disposable desktop/mobile fixtures. The owner has visually checked R12 on two real devices: PC 149 Practice attempts / 2 Readiness submissions / 10 backup zones; phone 116 / 2 / 10. Both independent device SHA-256 preflights displayed PASS and agreed with their own real learner progress dashboards. These are device-local, potentially overlapping histories and must not be summed or silently converted to 265 events. The screenshots do not prove a JSON was downloaded and preserved; keep separate archive files before a live release.

R6 created an atomic QA-only IndexedDB event journal/outbox. R8 returns SAVED only after a new canonical event is committed. However, R8 requires the caller to hold an identical event_id through errors and browser reloads. If the caller generates a new ID for a retry, an otherwise correct journal would count that retry as another answer. R13 closes this QA contract gap, not production integration.

docs.title: How R13 works
docs.text:
scripts/prototypes/math-v2-stable-submission-intent-r13.js uses a separate QA-only IndexedDB database math-v2-qa-submission-intents-r13. An opaque caller-provided submission_key stands for one single learner submission action, not a question ID and not a random ID regenerated on every retry. The key is unique together with an explicit synthetic learner scope.

  • Feature flag defaults off and no intent/journal write is attempted while disabled.
  • stage({submission_key,item_id,kind,correct?}) allocates event_id + occurred_at once in an IndexedDB readwrite transaction. Repeating the same key+payload returns the original event_id; a conflicting answer/content under the same key rejects safely.
  • commit(submission_key) loads that immutable intent and calls the reviewed R8 journal-first writer. A blocked/failed journal write returns NOT_SAVED; the staged intent remains ready for replay after reload.
  • Once the R6 event/outbox transaction commits, SAVED is true and R13 tries to mark the local intent receipt SAVED. The intent receipt and journal are separate databases, so there is no cross-database atomic transaction. A simulated crash after the journal commit but before the intent receipt leaves the original intent staged. Replaying the same event_id through R8 causes a duplicate acknowledgment but no extra count, then repairs the receipt.
  • pending() lists unresolved staged intents for that learner scope. It never invents historical attempts or mixes device identities.
  • Practice answers, submitted independent Readiness, and Written self-check use distinct canonical types. Written still yields zero automatic Readiness credit.

docs.title: Browser and QA checks
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-stable-submission-intent-r13-browser.py exercises real IndexedDB on disposable 1365px and 390px Chromium contexts with QA-only scope. It checks disabled mode, idempotent staging, conflicting answer rejection, simulated journal unavailability, reload-stable IDs/timestamps, true journal recovery, simulated loss of the local saved receipt, replay without double count, same-token concurrent submissions, scope isolation and byte-for-byte preservation of the original learner Practice/Readiness stores.

No R13 script is referenced from docs/ or mkdocs.yml. No live score calculations, existing question IDs, answer keys, localStorage keys, backup allowlist or school records change.

docs.title: Required before real activation
docs.text:
1. A production Practice/Readiness UI must allocate a unique submission token once per actual answer or test submit. The same question attempted again intentionally gets a NEW submission token; pressing retry on a failed save retains the original token and content.
  2. The UI must not show durable saved status or update canonical new counters until the event journal transaction commits.
  3. Provide learner-facing pending-intent diagnostics, retry action and device-specific identity; test browser quota/permission errors on real iPad Safari, cross-tab races and file-based export of any new authoritative event ledger.
  4. Resolve real assessment grading/result payloads as original authoritative evidence rather than using R13's unscored QA readiness event, and enforce independent Readiness versus formative/written separation.
  5. Obtain explicit owner QA gate, archive current real local progress on each device, label any clean v2 metric epoch and provide a rollback path. Legacy backups must remain separate from R11 QA JSON.

R13 QA PASS is not a license to replace production recording or delete old learner history.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R14 — Real Practice/Readiness hook → retry-safe v2 QA intent
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Scope: isolated Playwright QA, NOT a learner production integration

docs.title: Baseline
docs.text:
R13 (#499) was merged after full GitHub Actions QA PASS. It demonstrated one stable staged submission token/event ID through a failed write, browser reload, retry and a crash between journal commit and intent receipt. R13 did not connect this mechanism to real lesson interactions; existing R5 post-save observer callbacks were still wired only to R4/R7 prototypes in isolated tests.

R14 injects scripts/prototypes/math-v2-real-submission-intent-bridge-r14.js together with the unchanged R6/R8/R13 scripts into disposable Chrome contexts. It binds the existing MathV2CanaryBridgeR5 observer hooks of the actual Practice and Readiness pages to R13 staging and R8 journal commit.

docs.title: Verified event semantics in R14 browser QA
docs.text:
1. A successful original Practice answer triggers one staged FORMATIVE v2 intent with its own persisted ID; then R8 commits it into R6 event journal/outbox.
  2. A genuinely submitted Readiness check triggers a separate INDEPENDENT_ASSESSMENT intent. Neither source grants Written self-check or additional readiness credit.
  3. Existing original Practice and Readiness localStorage stores still receive their records, and normal score feedback remains authoritative for that legacy UX. The new QA counter is independent.
  4. In a controlled deferCommit fixture, the R5 hook saves the existing legacy record but stages the v2 intent without committing it. Refreshing the page preserves both staged IDs; a manual QA qaRecover() replays exactly those IDs and commits exactly one v2 event per intent. An additional retry creates no events.
  5. If original Practice/Readiness localStorage is corrupted and refuses a save, the existing R5 post-save hook does not fire: no new v2 staging or journal event is recorded.
  6. Browser tests cover desktop 1365px, mobile-width 390px, ordinary learner route script absence and untouched original localStorage outside explicitly simulated legacy submissions.

docs.title: Critical not-yet-solved production blockers
docs.text:
• Split write remains: the actual learner engine still saves legacy v1 first, then invokes R5 asynchronously. A browser closure/crash before R13 staging can lose the QA shadow event. An R13 retry cannot reconstruct a token that never reached the intent store. No user-facing v2 counter switch is safe on that path.
  • Unique submit tokens must be allocated by the real submission lifecycle BEFORE original success, not fabricated afterward by an observer. Repeating the same question as a genuinely new attempt must get a new key; a failed-save retry must reuse the old one.
  • Readiness here is recorded as an unscored v2 submission event. The original graded correct/answered/total/readiness_state payload must be carried over without regrading, and only after making the journal the durable source.
  • Existing R13 intents and R6 events live in separate QA databases. R10 backup covers the R6 journal/outbox but not the R13 staging database. A production backup/restore must also protect uncommitted intents or include an atomic production DB redesign.
  • Cross-device and multi-tab competing edits to old localStorage are still outside the QA observer's guarantees. PC and phone currently contain different real histories; never add them together or fake their timestamps.
  • No new scripts are in docs/ or global MkDocs loader. All production student routes and historical scores remain unchanged. A separate owner-controlled migration/release approval is mandatory.

docs.title: Next actual release requirement
docs.text: The next phase should refactor a narrow actual Practice/Readiness submission path behind an off-by-default official feature flag, with a single authoritative transaction / durable pending submission and visible saved-versus-unsaved feedback. Before any owner enables it, archive the separate original PC and phone real-progress files and verify the new backup includes pending intents. R14 is engineering evidence, not a production canary.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R15 — Journal-first Practice MCQ gate (QA off by default)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · State: Candidate, awaiting QA · NOT ENABLED FOR LEARNERS

docs.title: Achievement
docs.text:
R14 merged with full QA and demonstrated that original Practice/Readiness post-save hooks can stage stable R13 intents and replay without v2 duplicates. However, real learner routes still saved v1 before staging. A crash before intent staging could therefore leave a saved original attempt without v2 evidence. R15 tests the reverse order on one real Practice multiple-choice answer path only, under an injected flag that is absent by default.

In docs/assets/javascripts/practice-engine-v2.js, answer(selectedIndex) now checks window.MathV2PracticeCommitGateR15?.enabled === true before incrementing the session score or calling the existing record() writer. With no injected gate, the existing answer path and all rich-response cases behave unchanged. For QA, answerJournalFirst():

  1. Captures the selected answer and a caller-scoped stable submission_key for this specific attempt (a genuine new attempt receives a fresh token).
  2. Locks duplicate clicks and invokes an injected R15 gate, which uses reviewed R13 intent staging and R8/R6 atomic journal commit.
  3. On NOT_SAVED, leaves answered=false, old localStorage counters and current score untouched. Presents an explicit Thử lưu lại lượt này button that retains the original key and answer.
  4. On a durable SAVED acknowledgment, calls the original synchronous answer(selectedIndex, true) logic to preserve the existing feedback, skills, remediation and legacy save. If this subsequent legacy save fails, the existing warning still appears; v2 remains committed as the future authoritative evidence for the new epoch.
  5. The injected bridge scripts/prototypes/math-v2-practice-journal-first-gate-r15.js is only under scripts/, rejects non-QA_R15_ scopes and is never registered in mkdocs.yml. Its simulated journal failure is test-only. If a page reload loses the in-memory submission key but re-encounters the same unresolved question+answer, the bridge reuses the matching staged R13 token; a conflicting pending answer cannot silently overwrite it.

docs.title: Automated QA
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-practice-journal-first-r15.js checks source ordering, default-off loader isolation, same-key retry and authorization-before-old-score semantics.

scripts/test-math-v2-practice-journal-first-r15-browser.py runs disposable Chromium 1365px and 390px profiles: ordinary learner page unchanged without injection; deliberately fail first journal write, confirm no v2 event and no legacy score, staged ID remains; click retry, confirm one journal event and one original Practice attempt, no duplicate; reload, confirm durable journal; and verify ordinary successful journal-first single click. A synthetic localStorage sentinel must stay untouched.

docs.title: Explicit production blockers
docs.text:
• Not a release: R15 is not loaded on live learner pages, and only the MCQ answer path has a gated branch. Rich response questions and independent Readiness remain on their existing mechanisms.
  • Crash safety: R13 intent staging is durable, but if the tab closes after v2 journal commit and before the v1 feedback/save, the QA ledger already records that submission. Future learner UI must support resume and clear saved vs graded display after reload.
  • Source semantics: The R8/R13 prototype currently records a boolean Practice correct only; academic source tags, assistance state and independently graded Readiness results must be preserved and audited before production counters replace v1.
  • Backup: R10 currently archives R6 event/outbox only. Production must additionally archive uncommitted R13 intents or unify events, outbox and intents in one safe database, tested on PC and iPad.
  • Learner scope: R15 uses fixed synthetic per-test IDs. Production requires stable identity for one family learner, explicit separation from QA/history and a clean labeled v2 metric start. Old device histories are separate (PC 149 attempts vs phone 116 in the R12 screenshot), potentially overlapping; never sum them or invent event timestamps.
  • Rollout: A separately controlled feature flag, owner acceptance on actual Safari/iPad/PC and revert procedure are required. No silent historical deletion or score rewriting is permitted.

R15 QA PASS means only that the isolated journal-first Practice action works on synthetic sessions. It does not authorize a live switch of Readiness or existing student progress.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R16 — Single-database intent, event, outbox and atomic backup
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: QA prototype / owner cutover NOT AUTHORIZED

docs.title: Why R16 follows R15
docs.text: PR #501 (R15) is merged and its complete GitHub Actions run passed. The default-off Practice MCQ QA gate makes a journal save happen before the legacy score path. But the R13 staged-intent store and R6 event/outbox journal still reside in different IndexedDB databases. R10 backup covers only R6 events/outbox, not the unfinished R13 intents. This is a material portability/recovery gap: closing the browser after staging but before commit, then restoring the R10 file to another device, could drop an unresolved submission.

docs.title: QA-only unified ledger contract
docs.text:
scripts/prototypes/math-v2-unified-ledger-r16.js introduces a new, isolated math-v2-qa-unified-ledger-r16 IndexedDB database with three stores: intents, events, outbox. It never reads or rewrites real learner localStorage, R6/R10/R13 QA stores, or old scoring/history. Only synthetic scopes beginning with QA_R16_ may use it. Feature flag enabled defaults to false, and that path does not open a database.

  • Stage records submission_key, stable event_id, timestamp and typed Practice/Readiness/Written payload. The same key and content are idempotent; a changed answer under the same key is rejected. This first staged write is its own transaction and survives reload.
  • Commit uses one IndexedDB readwrite transaction across all three stores. The staged intent becomes SAVED, the immutable math-evidence-event-v2 is inserted and the corresponding pending outbox entry is added or none is written. Aborting the transaction must preserve the staged intent without an event/outbox or false confirmation. Retrying a committed key returns duplicate:true, not another score.
  • Read/Export snapshot all three stores within one readonly transaction, so a backup includes an unfinished staged intent along with committed events and pending outbox messages. A versioned math-v2-unified-ledger-backup-r16 JSON contains a SHA-256 integrity digest and strictly checked ownership/type linkage. Written self-checks retain zero automatic independent Readiness credit; ungraded Readiness stays separate.
  • Restore validates the entire backup and digest before starting writes; its replacement deletes/reinserts a single learner scope into all three stores within one readwrite transaction. Existing data refuses restore without explicit replace and acknowledged. A simulated abort leaves the prior snapshot byte-for-byte intact.
  • No v1 Practice/Core/Readiness history import or fabricated event timestamp/grade is attempted. Backup integrity is not authentication or cloud sync.

docs.title: Regression scope
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-unified-ledger-r16.js checks default-off isolation, one-database transaction boundaries, no localStorage/network/learner loader and strict feature scope.

scripts/test-math-v2-unified-ledger-r16-browser.py uses disposable Chromium desktop 1365px and mobile-width 390px contexts. It verifies a staged attempt stays unchanged across reload; deliberate commit abort rolls back all three stores; accepted and duplicate commits count once; simultaneous attempts from independent IndexedDB connections use the same event ID; a staged Written self-check remains in a signed exported backup; it transfers atomically to an independent browser context; signed tampering and foreign learner scope are rejected; occupied restore without explicit consent is refused; forced replacement abort preserves old data; after restore a pending intent can be committed exactly once and retained after reload.

docs.title: Gates still required before production activation
docs.text:
R16 is a stronger storage architecture prototype, not a full learner interface. The actual Practice path still uses the separate R13/R6 gate in default-off R15 QA, not the new R16 API; Readiness and rich answers are not journal-first. A subsequent bridge would have to test end-to-end grading on authoritative events, retry/resume after crash between journal commit and legacy feedback, correct association of a unique submission key with the actual learning session, the scored independent Readiness evidence, retention/backup limits, and true iPad Safari storage behavior.

For real learners, retain the R12 separately validated existing device backups. Device-local PC and phone histories may overlap and must not be summed. An owner-controlled, reversible cutover can start a clearly labeled fresh v2 epoch without inventing older event history. QA PASS or merge alone must never enable the new counter or erase old records.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R17 — Real Practice click → R16 unified ledger (QA only)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: QA CANDIDATE / NO LEARNER CUTOVER

docs.title: Starting point
docs.text: R15 (#501) and R16 (#502) were confirmed merged into main with full Github Actions PASS. R15 already added a default-off journal-first checkpoint to the real multiple-choice Practice click lifecycle, but its injected test adapter still relied on the old separated R13 intent DB and R6 journal DB. R16 supplied an improved one-transaction, one-IndexedDB API for intents, events and outbox, plus a SHA-256 backup containing unresolved intents. R17 connects these reviewed pieces in a new isolated QA adapter rather than adding another storage engine or altering the real student navigation.

docs.title: What is changed
docs.text:
scripts/prototypes/math-v2-practice-unified-ledger-gate-r17.js is an injection-only implementation of the existing MathV2PracticeCommitGateR15 interface. It:

  1. Runs only if Playwright explicitly injects __MATH_R17_QA_CONFIG__.enabled and the learner scope begins QA_R16_R17_.
  2. Opens the reviewed R16 unified ledger; no separate R6/R13 DB or localStorage entry is used.
  3. Receives the actual Practice MCQ answer selection before the existing Practice grading and legacy localStorage persistence, uses the R16 staged intent and commits all three event/intent/outbox records atomically.
  4. On a simulated transaction abort, retains the STAGED intent, reports NOT_SAVED, and permits retry with the same ID. No legacy score or old answer count is written before a successful R16 commit.
  5. On a reload/restore where a still-STAGED intent for the same item remains, reuses that exact submission_key and event_id. Ambiguous/mismatching pending answers fail closed, rather than changing the content associated with a previous attempt.
  6. Exposes test-only qaExport()/qaImport() that use R16's versioned SHA-256 backup, preserving outstanding staged intents along with events and pending outbox receipts.

The existing default-off R15 guard remains the only modification on the production Practice engine; R17 and R16 are not registered in mkdocs.yml, and normal learner pages do not load them.

docs.title: Regression tests
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-practice-unified-ledger-r17.js checks that only the reviewed R16 database is used and that no production script enables the gate.

scripts/test-math-v2-practice-unified-ledger-r17-browser.py runs actual Practice clicks in disposable Chromium desktop (1365px) and mobile-width (390px) contexts. The test covers: - Default learner path with the gate absent. - First R16 commit intentionally aborted: no event/outbox, staged intent remains, no v1 Practice grade. - Reload and real Practice click with the staged token: exactly one event, one outbox entry, one legacy Practice attempt and matching stable event ID. - Standalone R16 backup containing the still-STAGED intent; import into an independent browser/device fixture, then real Practice click recovers and commits that same ID. - Source isolation and no automatic Readiness or Written credit.

docs.title: Remaining production gates
docs.text:
R17 remains an engineering proof, not a production launch. Its unresolved-intent lookup by item_id and correct is suitable only for this controlled, one-question-at-a-time QA workflow: a full production implementation must associate a stable token with the exact learner session and submission action. Additionally, R16's QA backup has a 2 MB limit and its three-store journal is not wired to the actual permanent backup UI. A full family release must test iPad Safari IndexedDB/quota behavior, multiple-tabs, backup durability and reloading after commit but before on-screen feedback. It must also carry exact source evidence and independently graded Readiness results, without self-reported Written Readiness credit.

The verified R12 real legacy histories (PC 149/2; phone 116/2) must remain separately exportable. Do not add old totals together or silently backfill a fresh v2 journal. Obtain explicit owner signoff before any family learner canary or live counters.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R18 — Post-commit interruption / read-only reconciliation QA
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: ENGINEERING QA ONLY / NO FAMILY LEARNER CUTOVER

docs.title: Exact starting point
docs.text:
R17 PR #503 (merge 76cb3fb6f5c3650a2905bed19b325a004760bc2e) passed full public Math PR QA, MkDocs and Pages deployment. In R17 an actual Practice MCQ waits for the R16 atomic intent + event + outbox commit before calling original grading and the separate legacy toan-thcs-practice-v1 localStorage saver. That order prevents credit on an aborted v2 commit but has a post-commit / pre-v1 interruption window.

Do not claim exactly-once end-to-end v1+v2 scoring: IndexedDB v2 and old localStorage v1 cannot commit atomically together. Retrying legacy save without a durable receipt that represents the exact session/action/answer can duplicate the v1 attempt; repeating the same question after reload can also create a different v2 event if the old submission token was lost.

docs.title: R18 narrow change
docs.text:
New scripts/prototypes/math-v2-postcommit-reconciliation-r18.js is never loaded by MkDocs or real student pages. Explicit opt-in accepts only synthetic scopes prefixed QA_R16_R17_R18_. It reads the same R16 three-store snapshot and classifies a specific submission key:

Status Evidence Permitted automatic action NOT_FOUND No matching intent None; investigate UNCOMMITTED_RETRY_SAME_TOKEN STAGED, no event/outbox Retry exact existing token via separate reviewed writer COMMITTED_UI_UNCERTAIN SAVED + matching event/outbox Display v2 evidence only; never replay v1 INCONSISTENT_FAIL_CLOSED Missing/mismatching atomic receipt No score/replay; preserve data and investigate NOT_PRACTICE_EVIDENCE Readiness/Written intent Do not treat it as Practice

Its project() counts committed unique v2 event IDs only. Formative, independent Readiness and self-reported Written remain distinct, and Written never grants automatic Readiness. No write/clear/migration/localStorage/network endpoint is implemented. The API never asserts whether old UI feedback happened.

docs.title: Failure-window browser QA
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-postcommit-reconciliation-r18-browser.py injects the approved R16/R17 QA prototypes into disposable Chromium contexts, visits an actual Practice question, and simulates the missing acknowledgement after the real v2 atomic save but before R15 can invoke the old grading call:

  1. Immediately after the interruption: exactly one SAVED intent, v2 event, pending outbox; zero v1 attempt.
  2. Read-only inspection returns COMMITTED_UI_UNCERTAIN, not a permission to write v1.
  3. Exact-token db.commit(key) repeat is reported duplicate:true; still one event and zero v1.
  4. Reload and another same-origin tab see the same journal counts without phantom replay.
  5. A different deliberately aborted R16 transaction remains STAGED and contributes no v2 score.
  6. SHA-256 checked R16 backup containing both committed and unfinished intent restores into an isolated second device/browser store without inventing v1 points.
  7. 1365px desktop and 390px mobile-width Chromium paths both run.
  8. Default-off contract and pure Node state-classification tests run in PR CI.

This controlled hook models a lost commit acknowledgement (not a real device power cut or a Safari process kill). The successful QA result demonstrates a safe diagnosis, not a repaired learner-facing interface.

docs.title: Non-goals / boundaries
docs.text:
• No new production script, flag, account, progress counter, storage key, or QA tester menu.
  • No double-writes, replay-to-localStorage or automatic v1 score reconciliation.
  • No real learner backup import, cross-device history union, changes to Mastery/Readiness, or regrading.
  • No academic item editing; all canonical math IDs and lessons remain unchanged.
  • R16's 2 MB export limit and checksum are not a digital signature or a cloud sync promise.
  • In R17, recovery keyed by question ID and correctness is not a durable, unique identity for separate sessions or different incorrect options. R18 cannot solve that missing information retroactively.

docs.title: Decision before production
docs.text:
Next proof must add stable learner scope + session ID + question presentation instance + selected canonical option + submission action token and an explicit, journal-derived UI acknowledgement model. All later displays/counters should be projected from the authoritative committed event ledger; do not assume v1 and v2 can be repaired to match by repeat writes. Owner-controlled PC multi-tab + real Safari iPad testing, practical backup-size/quota failure checks and explicit owner approval are required before any family rollout or historical migration.

Release boundary: passing CI permits merging QA code only into public Math main; it is not approval to activate v2 on the family site.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R19 — Exact answer-action identity contract (QA only)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: QA CONTRACT CANDIDATE / NO LEARNER CUTOVER

docs.title: Why R19 follows R18
docs.text:
R18 PR #504 proved that when the R16 v2 journal commits but the legacy v1 grading callback is interrupted, a read-only examiner can identify the committed journal event without unsafe v1 replay. R17 recovered an unresolved intent using item_id + a Boolean correct. That lookup does not identify which wrong choice was selected or distinguish separate attempts/sessions.

R19 does not change Practice scoring. It formalizes and adversarially tests a stable identity vocabulary that a future single-transaction writer must persist along with the journal.

docs.title: Proposed canonical action envelope
docs.text:
• learner_scope: synthetic QA-only namespace (no real learner identifier)
  • session_id: one learning-session identity
  • presentation_id: a persistent identity for this rendering of a question, distinct when that same item is presented again
  • action_id: generated on the first answer selection; reused on a retry, not regenerated by a double-click
  • item_id: exact canonical question identity
  • source_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact immutable source version containing the canonical option ID and answer key
  • option_id: an actual source-locked option identity; not the displayed/shuffled position or translated option text
  • correct: the result of trusted deterministic grading (not user-submitted independent evidence)

Submission key = QA_R19_ + SHA-256(domain | scope | session ID | presentation ID). It intentionally does not include answer or action ID: if a user clicks a different choice or generates a new action token for the same rendered question, a future stored receipt must flag a conflict rather than creating a second canonical attempt.

Answer fingerprint = SHA-256(domain | item ID | source SHA | selected canonical option ID | correctness). It distinguishes two wrong choices even if both have correct:false.

docs.title: Prototype and tests
docs.text:
scripts/prototypes/math-v2-exact-action-identity-r19.js is a pure QA-injection-only capture/comparison helper. No IndexedDB, localStorage, network calls, production registration or migration. The Node adversarial regression tests:

  1. Same session/presentation/action and option produce the same submission key and fingerprint, including a simulated reload/reconstruction.
  2. Two different incorrect options share the same submission key but have distinct answer fingerprints and are rejected as changed-answer conflict.
  3. A changed action ID within the same presentation is rejected; a new presentation and session receive new keys.
  4. Any changed question ID or source SHA is rejected for the old presentation.
  5. Only explicitly source-locked option IDs and 64-hex SHA-256 source digests are accepted.
  6. R16's current Boolean-only event is explicitly classified R16_LACKS_EXACT_ACTION_PROVENANCE, NOT approved for automated replay/cutover.
  7. The helper's successful comparison remains EXACT_CAPTURE_MATCH_BUT_NOT_DURABLE; a pure function does not demonstrate crash recovery.

docs.title: Protected boundaries and remaining work
docs.text:
• This proof does not persist an action envelope. There is no R19 live capture, no automatic R16 journal write, and no Safari proof.
  • A production writer must store action identity and exact option fingerprint in the same IndexedDB transaction as intent + event + outbox, with a uniqueness constraint on (scope, session, presentation). A separate metadata database or dual-store replay cannot guarantee atomicity.
  • Generate and durably retain session_id, presentation_id, and first action_id before accepting a click; preserve exact source SHA/option ID from reviewed question data. Do not synthesize option IDs from shuffled positions silently.
  • Preserve SOURCE_REPORTED versus unavailable independent Readiness grades; never grant automatic Readiness from Written self-reports.
  • Do not import real PC/phone histories into the synthetic ledger or claim that old v1 totals have been migrated.
  • Owner-approved PC/iPad Safari canary, multi-tab concurrency, quota errors, backup coverage, and explicit release decision remain required before a production v2 switch.

Clearance boundary: Full public Math CI PASS permits merging this read-only QA contract into main, not deploying a live identity collector or changing learner scores.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R20 — Exact action + skill evidence in one atomic journal (QA only)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: QA CANDIDATE · NO LEARNER CUTOVER

docs.title: Why this exists
docs.text:
Owner goal: eventually unify reliable per-skill progress counters behind a single canonical event source. Formative Practice, independently graded Readiness, and self-reported Written remain distinct evidence classes; their counts must not be summed into a pseudo-mastery score.

R19 (#505) established pure stable identities (learner scope / session / presentation / first action / canonical chosen option / exact source SHA), but did not persist them. R20 experimentally persists the whole answer identity in the SAME IndexedDB as the staged intent, committed answer event and pending outbox. The event/intent/outbox transition occurs in one atomic transaction; there is no second metadata database.

docs.title: QA behavior
docs.text:
• New isolated database: math-v2-qa-exact-ledger-r20; only explicitly enabled QA_R16_R19_R20_... synthetic learner scopes.
  • First stage() writes exact option/action/source identity and reviewed skill references to one durable intent. Concurrent repeats of the same presentation reuse its unique submission key and original event ID.
  • A changed wrong option, changed first action, changed source, or inconsistent skill attribution for the same presentation is rejected, not interpreted as another attempt.
  • commit() writes the full evidence event, outbox receipt, and saved intent together. A simulated abort rolls all three back. Subsequent same-ID commit is idempotent.
  • project() counts each saved event ID once, and derives distinct per-skill Practice attempted/correct counters from its explicitly supplied skill_ids. A question may legitimately tag multiple skills: the sum of per-skill counters is not the number of unique answered questions. No system-verified mastery or Readiness credit follows from these numbers.
  • A single consistent read supports SHA-256 checksummed backup of both committed and unfinished intents; import requires scope match, hash verification, and explicit consent before replacing existing QA data. The checksum detects corruption, not malicious re-signing. 2 MiB QA size limit.
  • One standalone browser test (1365px desktop and 390px mobile-width Chromium) covers multi-connection stage/commit races, same-wrong-choice conflict, failed-commit rollback, reload, cross-browser export/import of SAVED + STAGED records, unchanged v1 storage and duplicate-free per-skill projection.

docs.title: What R20 does NOT claim
docs.text:
1. Not a live learner release. No mkdocs.yml entry, no Practice/Readiness engine import, no real student scores or backups, no actual school-session flag.
  2. Not a full unified Skill dashboard. This prototype handles only formative MCQ answer_attempt; grade-independent Readiness results, Written, remediation and exams need separately reviewed evidence contracts and safe projection.
  3. Not verified curricular skill mapping. R20 accepts supplied synthetic skill_ids for QA; future integration must obtain canonical skill mapping from reviewed content at the exact question version, not invent tags.
  4. Not self-authenticating scoring. R20 accepts synthetic correct and source digest from caller; future production connection must compute score from trusted reviewed source, not accept learner-supplied grading.
  5. Not v1/v2 dual-write atomicity. No replay into legacy localStorage. Do not migrate PC and phone histories automatically.
  6. Not Safari proof. Real family iPad Safari IndexedDB/quota, multiple tabs and browser-kill tests remain necessary.

docs.title: Next safe product step
docs.text:
Design an owner-visible read-only comparison of existing legacy counters versus canonical v2 evidence on synthetic/approved canary data. Show “not yet comparable” when the evidence has not been migrated rather than fabricating totals. Obtain owner approval before any real learner capture or cutover. Until then keep the family site on v1.

Release boundary: Full public Math CI PASS permits merging these isolated QA files only; it is not permission to enable experimental counters for family learners.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R21 — parent view for old/new Skill counters (read-only QA)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: QA CANDIDATE / NOT A LEARNER RELEASE

docs.title: Scope of the actual owner's question
docs.text:
Yes: Phase 4 is unifying how Skill progress is recorded and counted, not moving learners to a new dashboard yet. R20 #506 merged with full public Math QA/deploy PASS, proving that a QA-only Practice event can be stored atomically once and attributed to 1..N skills while the global unique-attempt total remains one.

R21 provides a separate, unlinked, noindex parent preview at /qa/math-v2-parent-comparison-r21.html. It uses only embedded synthetic V1-shaped per-item aggregates and V2 R20-shaped events. The helper is pure: no localStorage, IndexedDB, network, account, real backup input, import, migration, or learner score writes. Neither practice-engine-v2.js nor the site menu/config imports the R21 module.

docs.title: Comparison principles
docs.text:
1. Equal numbers are not sufficient: two totals both being two do not establish that the underlying attempts are the same; display NOT_COMPARABLE without shared event identities.
  2. A synthetic paired sample may report QA_MATCH only when an explicit synthetic-only proof lists every canonical event ID with the same item ID and correctness, and the replayed per-item aggregates exactly agree with the V1-shaped test figures. This verifies the algorithm, not real legacy lineage.
  3. Deliberately mismatched synthetic answers or missing proof rows return QA_MISMATCH. Corrupt counts, duplicate event IDs and out-of-scope events produce INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE instead of 0 or a match.
  4. V2 per-skill formative attempted/correct totals are projected from source-declared skill_ids on distinct event IDs. One multi-skill answer contributes to each relevant Skill; the sum of Skill attempts is not the global attempt count. This is not a mastery score.
  5. Readiness and Written are always marked NOT_COMPARABLE by R21 because the R20 prototype currently stores only Practice MCQ evidence. Written self-check does not become independently graded Readiness.
  6. Real V1 per-question aggregates lack corresponding per-attempt v2 IDs, so no authentic V1 device backup can pass the paired proof; do not transfer a synthetic fixture PASS into a claim that PC/iPad histories have been reconciled.

docs.title: What the parent may safely try
docs.text:
Open the unlisted QA page on desktop or iPad; choose one of three buttons: - Same numbers but no proven common attempts → Chưa thể đối chiếu. - Fully linked synthetic attempts → Khớp trong bộ dữ liệu MẪU. - Altered synthetic aggregate despite same event set → Không khớp trong bộ dữ liệu MẪU.

All results and per-Skill counts are clearly labelled synthetic. The preview intentionally has no file selector. No private real learner backup should be uploaded to it.

docs.title: QA gate
docs.text:
Node test scripts/test-math-v2-parent-comparison-r21.js checks exact synthetic lineage, unsupported parity, mismatch, corrupt counts, scope and duplicate protection, separate evidence lanes, no-loader/no-storage contract. Browser test scripts/test-math-v2-parent-comparison-r21-browser.py checks PC-width 1365px and mobile 390px, all three outcomes, Skill overlap, overflow, no new IndexedDB database, unchanged localStorage sentinel and no real Practice score. The tests are included in the existing public Math Roadmap PR Quality workflow.

No deployment approval for live v2 Skill counters. Next step (separate task/owner decision) is source-backed mapping from approved course content to stable skill IDs and source-derived grading, then real-device Safari/PC tests, privacy-safe backups, and an explicit learner cutover plan. Do not sum historical real PC/iPad counters or silently migrate V1.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R22 — kiểm tra nguồn gốc ánh xạ câu hỏi → Skill
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Scope: QA-only technical source integrity audit, NO LEARNER CUTOVER.

docs.title: Kết nối với giai đoạn hợp nhất bộ đếm
docs.text:
R18–R21 have provided a synthetic-only event ledger and parent counter comparison. R22 addresses the next essential question: which reviewed Skill/Family can an exact real question source be associated with? It does not turn a correct multiple-choice answer into a mastery declaration.

Existing reviewed source: - docs/assets/data/curriculum/skill-taxonomy-v2-registry-r1.json: 131 reviewed families; state I0_DURABLE_REGISTRY_RUNTIME_DISABLED. - docs/assets/data/curriculum/taxonomy-v2-runtime/index-r1.json: 24 compiled topic policies, CT02–CT25; 3,114 original policy rows. Historical index summary: 2,900 FAMILY_LINK_REVIEWED, 214 FORMATIVE_ONLY_NO_FAMILY. - Per-topic ctXX-r1.json links each question ID and original source chunk to a Git blob SHA-1, legacy skill tags, reviewed Family role and evidence category. - The policy itself explicitly has runtime_enabled:false, learner_data_write_enabled:false, independent_credit_authorized:false. These are binding safety boundaries, not toggles R22 overrides.

docs.title: R22 QA source-lock audit
docs.text:
scripts/prototypes/math-v2-source-locked-skill-audit-r22.js walks the compiled historical policy slice and performs a read-only comparison to the current repository file bytes: 1. Recompute exact Git blob SHA for each policy-declared question chunk and compare with the declared source blob and per-item source SHA. 2. Confirm question IDs are unique, the policy counts match, and each referenced item still exists in its exact declared file. 3. Require source question tags.skill to agree exactly with compiled policy legacy_skill_tags; never infer or rename a Skill from convenient similar text. 4. Check the MCQ answer key is structurally an in-range option index; this is not mathematical re-review or trusted production scoring. 5. For intact records classify: - SOURCE_LOCKED_FAMILY_QA_ONLY: reviewed family association exists and is still source-matched. - SOURCE_LOCKED_NO_FAMILY_QA_ONLY: original policy explicitly chose no Family/Skill credit. Do not fill this gap using raw tags. - *_HOLD: changed source, missing ID, mismatched tags, malformed answer or inconsistent policy; no Skill attribution. 6. Output only aggregate QA diagnostics, per-topic counts and small examples. Never write events, learner scores, v1 history, or R20 database.

A source-locked Family is not automatically an assessed Skill credit: mapping roles include METHODS, CONTEXT, CATEGORY, supporting tags, and partial MCQ evidence. R22 neither attributes every tag to a separate count nor awards Ready/Mastery/Readiness, regardless of correctness.

docs.title: Incomplete coverage is expected and must be explicit
docs.text:
The 3,114 policy rows are a historical compiled slice, not the entire latest interactive Practice player. For example, the current CĐ02 v4 manifest declares 149 questions, and CĐ04 v6 declares 142, including later rich-answer additions absent from the old base coverage. R22 does NOT claim that a 3,114-row audit covers all latest Practice questions.

Also, source-backed option arrays use a positional answer index. They do not provide reviewed canonical stable option IDs needed for the R19/R20 exact-action capture. R22 checks valid indices but marks canonical_option_ids_verified:false, prohibiting production migration or trusted cross-version dedup.

QA PASS meaning: the auditor preserves explicit HOLD statuses and does not silently invent skill links. The count of fully source-locked records is reported by the actual CI; no blanket “all 3,114 verified” claim is made in advance.

docs.title: Tests and owner gate
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-source-locked-skill-audit-r22.js validates the full source set and CT02 sample, changed source SHA, changed legacy tags, no-family handling, protected runtime flags, unchanged site/Practice loader, and no storage/network writes.

Only after public Math full PR CI PASS may QA-only audit files be merged into main. This release changes neither academic source banks nor real UI. Later separate work must reconcile latest manifests, confirm canonical option identities and source-derived grade calculations, and receive parent QA/authorization for PC/iPad Safari before activating learner Skill counters.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R23 — Current Practice catalog vs historical Skill policy
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: Read-only engineering QA · no student rollout.

docs.title: Objective
docs.text:
R22 audited the 3,114 question IDs in 24 academically compiled Skill Taxonomy v2 topic policies (CT02–CT25). It found:

  • 2,750 rows with historically reviewed Family associations and unchanged source Git blobs (QA candidates only).
  • 214 rows explicitly classified formative-only/no Family.
  • 150 source-lock holds because their source file Git blob SHA changed.

Important distinction: A changed source blob does NOT prove each of its 150 historical items changed text or became mathematically wrong. Even whitespace or addition of a new question changes the blob. R23 does not override those holds or silently promote old Skill tags to reviewed evidence.

docs.title: R23 technical change
docs.text:
scripts/prototypes/math-v2-practice-manifest-drift-r23.js runs purely from repository files and imports the R22 read-only audit. For each CT02–CT25 topic, it:

  1. Locates versioned manifest files and selects the highest numeric version as a catalog candidate. It does not assume that version is the currently deployed Practice player.
  2. Checks the actual topic bai-tap.md for a direct data-practice-bank-v2 reference to that manifest. A manifest absent from the page is marked candidate-only, not asserted live.
  3. Loads all declared question chunks from the selected manifest. Duplicate item IDs or a declared question-count mismatch fail closed.
  4. Compares every candidate question ID against the exact historical policy question IDs, partitioning records into shared historical IDs, new unreviewed IDs, and historical IDs absent from the newer candidate. Missing in a candidate does not mean deleted across the site.
  5. Separates newly added simple MCQ items from response_type + answer_contract rich-answer questions, which need a different validated scoring/identity contract.
  6. Reports changes in exact source-chunk Git blobs, moved question IDs, page references, and a short per-topic review queue. Source drift remains blocked; no changed file is approved automatically.
  7. Prints machine-readable aggregates and affected topic summaries in GitHub CI logs. No current learner localStorage/IndexedDB, no network, no writes, no alterations of test content or taxonomy mapping.

docs.title: Interpretation and limits
docs.text:
The highest-version manifest is an available catalog, not a guarantee of learner exposure. Some topic pages don't directly include that manifest; some newer rich responses might be accessible through other routes. Those cases need a separate live wiring audit.

R23 does not recover the previous historical version of a modified source chunk, compare per-question text, regrade mathematics, or issue NotebookLM PASS. The 150 rows remain on HOLD until original and current question payloads can be compared and any required academic review is approved.

Also, structural validity of the answer index is not proof of mathematical correctness or a persistent canonical option ID. Readiness and Written self-reports remain distinct evidence lanes.

docs.title: Acceptance gate and next action
docs.text:
scripts/test-math-v2-practice-manifest-drift-r23.js asserts the R22 baseline (2,750 / 214 / 150), partitions every latest-manifest candidate without double counting, identifies CT02 v4 and CT04 v6, keeps non-referenced manifests candidate-only, and forbids student data reads/writes.

Public Math PR Quality must PASS at the exact head SHA before QA-only merge. No student production code or source items are edited, no score is reset or migrated.

After R23: Review individual old/current question versions for the drifted source chunks, and route previously unreviewed new MCQ/rich items through separate source/academic QA. Never award core Skill Mastery from a historical Family label alone.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R25 — Reviewed source exception shadow (QA only)
docs.text: Date: 2026-10-17 · Status: source integrity candidate; no learner cutover.

docs.title: Why R25 follows R22–R24
docs.text:
R22's strict whole-file SHA check found 2,750 source-locked family candidate rows, 214 formative/no-Family rows, and 150 holds among 3,114 historical questions. R23 verified the five changed chunks and found 59 additional latest-catalog question IDs (49 MCQ/10 rich). R24's original assumption that four CT08 notation edits still needed independent review was corrected after locating the already existing, exact-id NotebookLM notation-only lock:

  • review-packets/academic-depth/ct08-p1a/01_CT08_P1A_NOTATION_ACADEMIC_LOCK_R1.json: NOTEBOOKLM_R1_APPROVED_NOTATION_ONLY_EXCEPTION, exact four EQ08V1_047..050 question/explanation replacements, original reviewed source SHA, protected fields.
  • review-packets/academic-depth/ct09-p1c1/01_CT09_PRACTICE_ACADEMIC_LOCK_R1.json: all 120 historical CT09 item payloads, allowing only additive variant_group.
  • review-packets/academic-depth/ct09-p1c2/04_CT09_P1C2_OWNER_QA_PASS.md: owner QA PASS for released 129-question / 27-group CT09 integration.

R25 adds an isolated command-line QA reconciliation using those existing locks. It cross-checks all 150 historical records against their reviewed payloads and five exact observed current Git blob SHAs. This is stricter than treating an altered file SHA as proof all of its questions changed. It also refuses new blob changes even if they only add whitespace.

docs.title: Current supported partition (subject to exact-head CI)
docs.text:
Status Count Interpretation R22 original source-locked historical Family candidate 2,750 Already held to original reviewed source blobs R22 explicit formative/no Family 214 Never infer a Family from raw skill tags R25 reviewed unchanged item records inside changed files 26 Same exact question payload as archived lock R25 reviewed CT08 notation-only edits 4 Existing CT08 P1 narrow approval; no changed answer/skill R25 reviewed CT09 variant metadata-only edits 120 Existing CT09 P1-C1/P1-C2 metadata/owner QA QA-reconcilable historical Family candidate total 2,900 2,750 + 26 + 4 + 120; not a production Skill credit Historical Taxonomy source SHA holds pending controlled refresh 150 Frozen whole-file pins stay unchanged; no silent patch Newer candidate-bank IDs outside the historical 3,114-row policy 59 Nine CT09 P1-C2 IDs have separate review receipts; this R25 shadow assigns none of the 59 a new Skill credit

A source-reconciled Family candidate is not an independent graded Skill achievement. Classification roles include methods, partial MCQ evidence and contextual evidence. Neither the reviewed source lock nor the R25 shadow supplies stable canonical option identities, verified mastery thresholds, Readiness scores, or v1/v2 cross-device reconciliation.

docs.title: Safety boundaries
docs.text:
• Run only node scripts/test-math-v2-reviewed-source-exception-shadow-r25.js or the read-only CLI. No browser registration or Production Practice injection.
  • The source SHA pins in ct08-r1.json and ct09-r1.json remain frozen, and R22's 150 source holds are not silently erased. The separate shadow explains which differences are already covered by a narrowly reviewed exception.
  • A future source or lock change fails closed, as does a change to the 3,173-question candidate catalog or the 59-item newer-question partition. Test cases simulate whitespace-only source changes, altered variants, and withdrawal of the CT08 academic approval.
  • No localStorage, IndexedDB, learner dataset, state migration, content changes, automatic mastery or Readiness credit.
  • Before an eventual production Skill counter switch: controlled reviewed source-version contract, stable option/action IDs, revised full Practice inventory, independent evidence lanes, family PC/iPad Safari canary, and explicit owner cutover authorization.

Release gate: Exact-head full public Math CI PASS only authorizes merge of this read-only QA code and note; it does not grant a Skill counting production release.

docs.title: Math Phase 4 R26 — 59 câu mới: bảng bằng chứng theo từng mã (chỉ QA)
docs.text: Ngày: 2026-10-17 · Không chuyển bộ đếm Skill, không cập nhật dữ liệu học sinh.

docs.title: Mục đích
docs.text:
R23 xác định 59 mã câu có trong các manifest Practice mới nhất (dạng catalog candidate) nhưng chưa nằm trong 3.114 dòng chính sách Taxonomy v2 cũ. Đây không có nghĩa cả 59 câu đều chưa được duyệt học thuật. R25 đã khép lại đối chiếu kỹ thuật 150 câu lịch sử dựa trên hồ sơ độc lập đã có; R26 không đụng lại nguồn và chỉ phân loại 59 câu còn ngoài chính sách.

scripts/prototypes/math-v2-new-item-evidence-register-r26.js in đầy đủ 59 dòng có ID chính xác kèm chuyên đề, file nguồn, SHA Git blob hiện tại, manifest ứng viên, loại câu, mã bài nguồn (nếu có), đường dẫn biên bản đã tìm được và trạng thái liên kết học thuật. node scripts/prototypes/math-v2-new-item-evidence-register-r26.js xuất JSON kiểm toán; không đọc dữ liệu người học.

docs.title: Thống kê theo nguồn, không suy đoán trạng thái đã phát hành
docs.text:
Chuyên đề MCQ mới Rich nhập đáp án Tổng Ghi chú CT02 27 2 29 Các bài rich thuộc W1 CT03 4 2 6 Các bài rich thuộc W1 CT04 6 4 10 Rich thuộc W1, W2A, W2B CT09 9 0 9 Có PASS NotebookLM P1-C2, owner QA và extension riêng CT12 3 0 3 Ngoài policy cũ, chưa liên kết biên bản duyệt theo từng ID trong R26 CT21 0 2 2 Rich thuộc W1 Tổng 49 10 59

Ba nhóm bằng chứng (không phải ba mức điểm) được phân biệt:

  • 9 CT09 P1-C2: có đúng mã SYS09V1_121..129, biên bản NotebookLM, owner QA và source-locked shadow extension ct09-p1c2-extension-r1.json. Tuy nhiên independent_credit_authorized=false, không chấm Core Readiness/Mastery.
  • 10 rich typed-answer: 8 biến thể được nối nguồn từ W1 đã ra mắt; 1 từ W2A và 1 từ W2B có biên bản PASS học thuật tương ứng. R26 xác nhận đúng cặp mã câu mới → mã bài nguồn, nhưng những biên bản này không cấp quyền tự động nhận câu rich như một lượt làm tự luận có chấm độc lập; chưa có family mapping source-lock cho 10 item này.
  • 40 MCQ còn lại: R26 chưa xác định được biên bản duyệt theo từng ID mới và không được tự tuyên bố “chưa từng duyệt”. Chúng yêu cầu đối chiếu các gói nguồn/QA liên quan, đánh giá mapping và khóa SHA trước khi bổ sung vào chính sách bộ đếm mới.

docs.title: Hàng rào không được vượt qua
docs.text:
1. Một manifest có phiên bản lớn nhất chỉ là ứng viên danh mục; việc file bai-tap.md có dẫn trực tiếp đến manifest cũng không đủ chứng minh tất cả route/cấu hình thực tế. R26 không tự công bố câu nào “đang live”.
  2. Một nội dung đã NotebookLM PASS hoặc owner QA PASS cho phép xét tình huống tương ứng; không đồng nghĩa một câu trả lời đúng có thể cộng ngay điểm thành thạo. Hợp đồng đáp án chuẩn, mã lựa chọn bất biến, nguồn chấm và lớp chứng cứ phải được xử lý riêng.
  3. R26 không sửa ctXX-r1.json, ct09-p1c2-extension-r1.json, ngân hàng Practice, metadata học thuật, hay bộ đếm v1 hiện hành.
  4. Không thực hiện ghép lịch sử nhiều thiết bị, regrade, di chuyển dữ liệu cũ hoặc tự tạo/Deploy Forms.
  5. Nếu tổng danh mục 3.173 hoặc phân vùng 59 thay đổi, QA thất bại để yêu cầu kiểm tra phiên bản nguồn.

docs.title: Thực thi và bước kế tiếp
docs.text:
• Node CI: scripts/test-math-v2-new-item-evidence-register-r26.js.
  • Output tổng kết số lượng theo từng chủ đề; bảng 59 ID đầy đủ được tạo theo nội dung repo hiện tại khi chạy CLI.
  • Hướng tiếp theo: tìm biên bản theo đúng ID cho 40 MCQ chưa nối được; đối chiếu học thuật/nguồn cho 10 câu rich và bản đồ Family; chuẩn hóa stable option IDs và score provenance trước khi lập kế hoạch PC/iPad Safari canary có sự đồng ý của phụ huynh.

Quyết định phát hành: CI PASS chỉ cho phép hợp nhất mã kiểm toán QA, tuyệt đối chưa bật Skill v2 cho học sinh.
